title: Karbobala Mein Kaisi Qayamat Guzar Gayi
body:
Karbobala me kaisi qayamat guzar gayi bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
Nauhakuna thi dasht e musibat me zindagi bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Lashkar ki shaan kaafla salaar na raha..
Sarwar tadhap ke roye alamdaar na raha..
Maktal me kis kadar hai musibat ki yeh ghadhi, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Manzar na yeh kisi ko dikhaye mera khuda..
Pehlu me ek bhai ke bhai guzar gaya..
Paiwast teer aankh me be dast tha jari, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haaye jawaan bhai tha battees saal ka..
Woh jo hua hussain se pardes me juda..
Bole hussain chhodh ke jao na aye akhee ,bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dil pe badan pe rooh pe sheh ki hua asar..
Kham ho gayi hai hazrat e shabbir ki kamar..
Jeene ki dil me aarzoo baaki nahi rahi ,bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kehte the shah aye mere abbas e bawafa..
Ek baar bhai kehke pukaro hame zara..
Bhai ka lafz honto pe aaya hi tha abhi, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Girye ne sheh ke arsh e moalla hila diya..
Nauha fiza e dasht e bala me suna gaya..
Sarwar pe roti reh gayi maktal me bekasi, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Manzar woh qatl gaah ka"SALMAN AZMI"..
Lafzo'n me kar sakega na tehreer koi bhi..
Kaafi hai rone walo ko jumla bus ek yahi, bhai ka dam nikal gaya bhai ke saamne
